I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, so I can only give you an approximate figure based on recent market levels.

At the time of writing, the USD/GBP rate has been hovering around **0.77–0.78**. Using a mid‑point of **0.775**, $20 would be roughly:

\[
\$20 \times 0.775 \;=\; £15.50
\]

So you can expect about **£15½** for $20, but keep in mind that the exact amount will vary with the current market rate and any fees your bank or payment provider may add. If you need the precise figure for a transaction, it’s best to check a reliable financial news source, your bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app right before you make the transfer.
